pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with moderately sharp pixel-level edge gradients. Patch spatial area is maximal on the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more irregular shapes toward the lower neck and ventral margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-radial and quadri-radial connectivity. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the flank, with slight compression visible near the shoulder transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette visible along the neck mane. The hair-to-background interface shows distinct pixel-level irregularities consistent with stiff mane texture.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A notable structural break in the mane profile is visible at the transition point between the posterior neck and the dorsal hump.
